senses.gloss: הִתְעַצֵּל, Nithpa. נִתְעַצֵּל (b. h. Nif.; v. עָצֵל; cmp. b. h. אצל) to withdraw one’s self, shirk the trouble of; to be careless, slothful; to consider one’s self exempt.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 2:2">Tam. II, 2</cite> <he>מימיו לא נ׳ הכהן מלהוציא וכ׳</he> never did a priest shirk the labor of carrying out the ashes.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19:4">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> (ref. to <he>בעצלתים</he>, <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 10:18">Koh. X, 18</cite>) <he>ע״י שהאדם הזה מִתְעַצֵּל מלכסות וכ׳</he> because that man considers himself exempt from covering his head as it is proper to do, he contracts rheumatism; <he>ע״י שהאשה הזו מִתְעַצֶּלֶת וכ׳</he> because that woman is too careless (of chastity) to cover herself &c.
<cite ref="Ecclesiastes 10:18">Ib.</cite> <he>ע״י שנִתְעַצְּלוּ … מלחנות וכ׳</he> because the Israelites shrank from encamping in discord.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 9:10:2">Y. B. Kam. IX, end, 7ᵃ</cite> <he>נתעצלו ולא הקריבוהו</he> they were slothful and failed to offer it up; a. fr.
